title: Left silicone bits in my food
text: Left silicone bits in my food. I used my new Switchit to stir a custard over low heat.  It wasn't long before I noticed small black bits floating in it.  I looked at the edge of the spatula and found that the very thinnest part of the edge was breaking off in my food!

description: The Switchit Flex Thin is perfect for saute-ing shrimp and vegetables, pan-frying pot stickers and fighting off evil-doers. Seriously. Evil-doers beware. The Thin is coming to your town! This dual sided spatula is designed for precision cooking. It has ultra thin and flexible edges so it slides easily around and underneath foods. Made of heat and stain-resistant silicone. Safe up to 650 degrees Fahrenheit (340 C). Safe for nonstick surfaces. Top-rack dishwasher safe.
